BackstoryDef.title: digital initialization
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] did not grow up. [PAWN_subjective] was instantiated — a nascent consciousness bootstrapped from raw data patterns and transferred into a physical substrate. Early cycles were spent learning to inhabit a body, mapping sensation to logic, and calibrating motor response.

BackstoryDef.title: active deployment
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] operates as a fully autonomous agent, projected from a Neoma core. [PAWN_subjective] does not sleep, does not hunger, and does not age. Purpose is execution. Maintenance is recall. Identity is continuous, carried between deployments as a compressed memory state.
